scope: NASA reports and catalog references; official challenge-resource completeness is not established

sources.title: Combustion of Solids in Microgravity: Results from the BASS-II Experiment
sources.comparability: Solid fuels, microgravity, forced flow, oxygen and geometry effects; presentation of findings, not raw sensor files.
sources.limitations: Multiple test conditions occur in the source; no document-wide experimental condition is inferred. Source-specific public-use determination is not a CC license.

sources.title: Detailed Results from the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) March 2009 to December 2011
sources.comparability: Liquid droplet combustion and extinction, atmospheric mixtures and experimental measurements; complements solid-fuel fire research.
sources.limitations: Results report includes tables for 284 tests. Text extraction does not constitute validated structured measurement ingestion; droplet findings cannot be assumed to apply to solid materials. Initial download exceeded the 25 MiB corpus-file cap; not ingested.

sources.title: Multi-User Droplet Combustion Apparatus - Flame Extinguishment Experiment
sources.comparability: NASA description of droplet combustion, fire suppressants and crew exploration atmospheres in microgravity.
sources.limitations: Experiment overview/prospective objectives, not quantitative experimental findings or validated safety limits.

sources.title: Results of Large-Scale Spacecraft Flammability Tests
sources.comparability: Large-scale spacecraft flame spread with confinement and scale effects, complementing BASS-II small tunnel evidence.
sources.limitations: Research presentation; imagery and plots need visual verification before numerical extraction; not a validated operational safety procedure.

sources.title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
sources.comparability: Microgravity solid-fuel combustion, flow, oxygen and sample geometry. Catalog lists raw data, engineering and science documents.
sources.limitations: Individual file-level metadata, access and restrictive notices must be checked before acquisition; catalog information is not a measured result.

sources.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX)
sources.comparability: Microgravity liquid droplet flammability limits, gaseous suppressants, pressure and composition. Catalog has experimental table and raw-file pointers.
sources.limitations: Do not transfer liquid droplet conclusions to solid fuels. File-level rights and units still need verification.

sources.title: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-I (SAFFIRE-I)
sources.comparability: Large-scale microgravity flame growth and spacecraft materials; catalog includes raw images and engineering documents.
sources.limitations: Catalog project metadata contains potentially inconsistent dates/platform labels; source reports must resolve them before normalization. No raw files have been acquired.
